notes: Semantic validation, native permissions, hashes and revision checks are additionally required; JSON Schema alone is not authorization.
Per-file export and trusted interactive OAuth import are implemented locally; live client compatibility and durable deployment acceptance remain pending.
Successful and partial outputs are defined here; errors use the existing MCP error channel with categorical reasons.

tools.name: get_assignment_grading_context
tools.description: Read authoritative assignment configuration and scoped grading capabilities.

tools.name: list_assignment_submissions
tools.description: Page eligible students and current submission metadata, including missing rows.

tools.name: get_assignment_submission
tools.description: Read one authorized current submission, bounded inline evidence and existing feedback.

tools.name: export_assignment_submissions
tools.description: Capture selected current content into bounded temporary private artifacts; no academic mutation.

tools.name: get_assignment_submission_export
tools.description: Read export status and paginated immutable artifact inventory.

tools.name: save_assignment_grades
tools.description: Validate or save exactly approved point grades and feedback without releasing; explicit TA approval required for commit.

tools.name: release_assignment_grades
tools.description: Validate or return selected saved grades and synchronize their verified external Gradebook projection; separate release approval required.

tools.name: get_assignment_grades
tools.description: Independently read exact Assignment and linked Gradebook values for selected targets.

tools.name: get_assignment_grading_operation
tools.description: Read and reconcile a known principal-bound save or release receipt without committing pending work.
